milestone: M56 Arbitrary Repository Coding Golden Journey

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: A headless drive can bind the admitted arbitrary-repository objective/context task run to one deterministic reviewable workspace proposal candidate and route the caller to explicit review/authorization.
The phase reuses the existing non-mutating workspace.write proposal path and does not apply, approve, preflight, or mutate files.
Candidate identity is derived from durable task/run/proposal events and persisted in bounded drive and journey checkpoint metadata for exact replay.
Rust owns candidate selection, ambiguity denial, replay conflict checks, and bounded next-action routing; VSIX only validates the protocol shape.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with direct support from controlled_workspace_tools, persistent_structured_ledger, context_management, and runtime_permission_enforcement.
answers.new_capability: headless.run.drive can now expose one bounded objective-scoped proposal candidate for an M56.1 admitted journey when the admitted task/run generated exactly one valid pending workspace proposal.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: task.run and proposal.list can create and inspect proposals, but they do not bind one proposal to the admitted journey objective/context fingerprints, source task/run, replay identity, and next action.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The Golden Journey would still require caller-side proposal selection and could not safely progress from admitted coding task to reviewable code-change candidate under Rust provenance.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M56.1 objective/context admission, M55.1 admission atomicity, and M54.2 technical-debt transition gating because this crosses the next non-mutating proposal-candidate boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends existing headless.run.drive result and journey checkpoint metadata; it does not add a new JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds bounded candidate metadata to existing drive/journey structures and no report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary endpoint.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust derives the candidate from durable WorkspacePatchProposed evidence, rejects malformed or ambiguous candidate evidence, routes ready candidates to review_and_authorize_objective_proposal, and verifies exact replay against the persisted candidate fingerprint.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled controller receives a deterministic proposal handle and bounded next action without parsing raw ledger ordering or guessing among unrelated proposals.
answers.milestone_progress: Moves M56 from arbitrary objective/context admission to a runtime-owned reviewable proposal candidate, enabling later approval/preflight, apply, verification, recovery, and accepted-completion phases.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive exposes exactly one bounded objective_proposal_candidate when an admitted objective-context task/run produces one valid pending workspace proposal

candidate metadata is bound to journey/session/drive ids, source task/run ids, proposal id, operation, validation and approval status, source event, objective/context fingerprints, and candidate fingerprint
ready candidates set next_action and next_route to review_and_authorize_objective_proposal
exact replay returns the same candidate metadata without duplicate task, proposal, drive checkpoint, or drive-completed events
zero, multiple, malformed, invalid, blocked, non-pending, recovery-scoped, unrelated, stale, or conflicting evidence fails closed before side effects
no file is applied, approved, rejected, preflighted, or mutated
no new JSON-RPC method or wrapper/report/readiness/history/digest/inspection surface is added

RPC and ledger-facing payloads exclude raw prompts, provider responses, file content, proposed content, hunks, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_binds_objective_workspace_proposal_candidate_and_replays covers successful candidate binding, next route, bounded metadata, and exact duplicate-free replay
Rust behavior test headless_objective_workspace_proposal_candidate_denies_ambiguous_or_non_pending_evidence covers zero-candidate fail-closed metadata and ambiguous valid pending proposal denial
Existing M56.1 objective-context journey admission tests continue to cover selected context freshness, replay, and conflict denial
VSIX protocol tests accept bounded objective proposal candidate metadata and reject malformed or raw-data-bearing candidate payloads

safety_boundary: reuses existing dry-run workspace.write proposal generation and WriteWorkspace permission gates
identifies and binds proposal metadata only; it does not approve, reject, preflight, apply, or mutate files
ambiguity is denial rather than ordering-based selection
persists only bounded ids, statuses, counts, and SHA-256 fingerprints
non_goals: no file apply or proposal approval
no shell, git, network, provider, service, verifier, scheduler, or daemon expansion
rejected_alternatives: caller-side proposal.list ordering as the Golden Journey candidate boundary
a new proposal candidate inspection endpoint
persisting raw proposal content or diffs in journey metadata
technical_debt: The candidate boundary currently handles the first admitted objective-context task/run only; later M56 phases should route explicit approval/preflight and apply for the same candidate identity.
Runtime lib.rs remains large and should be split only by a later behavior-preserving MOVE-only refactor.
next_capability_rationale: M56.3 should move from the bounded objective proposal candidate to explicit review/authorization and latest preflight for that same candidate without automatic apply.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M56.2 updates current and archived phase-value manifests for the objective-scoped workspace proposal candidate slice. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and no wrapper/report/readiness surface was added.
